test_title: PYST 6: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

To send someone to Coventry

options.text: To exile someone to a faraway place

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **To ignore someone deliberately**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To send someone to Coventry"** means to intentionally ignore or exclude someone from communication or interaction. (किसी को जानबूझकर अनदेखा करना) • **Example:** After his betrayal, the entire team sent him to Coventry, refusing to talk to him. • This idiom implies social isolation or silent treatment as a form of punishment or disapproval. Therefore, the correct answer is: **To ignore someone deliberately**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **To award someone symbolic punishment** (किसी को प्रतीकात्मक सजा देना): This refers to giving a punishment that represents disapproval but does not have a real consequence. • **Example:** The school awarded symbolic punishment by making him apologize publicly. • **To exile someone to a faraway place** (किसी को दूरस्थ स्थान पर निर्वासित करना): Refers to banishing or sending someone away to a remote location. • **Example:** In ancient times, traitors were often exiled to faraway islands. • **To mock someone publicly** (किसी का सार्वजनिक रूप से मजाक उड़ाना): Refers to ridiculing or making fun of someone in a public setting. • **Example:** The comedian’s act mocked several politicians publicly. 4e:Tb6c, The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **A source of controversy and trouble**.
